home.heroSubtitle: Search verified breeders and foundations across Europe, apply with confidence, and — when it's time — arrange trusted transport from pickup to handover.

footer.tagline: A dedicated European animal ecosystem — verified breeders, foundation adoptions and a trusted community, with safe transport available every step of the way.
footer.welfareDisclaimer: Havenpaw does not guarantee the health or behaviour of any animal, nor a fixed transport delivery time before review.
